fields.quoted_span: (B) (i) Use a person’s credit history as part of the application process for a rental accommodation without offering the applicant the option, at the applicant’s discretion, of providing lawful, verifiable alternative evidence of the applicant’s reasonable ability to pay
fields.note: Most of the requirement tracks subdivisions (a), (c), (n), (o) and (p). The credit-history sentence omits that the rule applies only where there is a government rent subsidy. The 'No Section 8' example is not in this document.

fields.quoted_span: “Source of income” includes a federal Department of Housing and Urban Development Veterans Affairs Supportive Housing voucher.
fields.note: Section 8 is covered in subdivision (p)(1). Alternative evidence in place of credit history is in (o)(1)(B). The tenant-portion income standard is in (o)(1)(A).
